verbatim_quote.original: ایشوی گیت‌هابشون هم با کامنت ببندی.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Close their GitHub issues with a comment too.

extracted_decision.summary: GitHub issues linked to closed tasks are closed with a closing comment carrying the feature commit hashes.
extracted_decision.rationale: Keeps issue state in sync with the local Kanban both ways.
alternatives: Leave the issue open after task closure
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: None; comment preserves the full trace.
